summary.name: Volant
summary.one_liner: Volant is a free, open-source native Mac launcher for apps, files, contacts, calculations, notes, clipboard history, and AI coding agents.
use_cases: launch apps and find files from the keyboard
do quick calculations and unit or currency conversions
keep Markdown notes as plain files
reply to AI agent sessions without switching tabs
limit distracting apps and sites while working
summary.what_it_does: Volant is a native macOS launcher opened with a single shortcut. It finds apps, files, and contacts, and can join upcoming meetings from the search bar. It evaluates calculations, converts units and currencies, checks time zones, and shows Apple Weather forecasts inline. Clipboard history and reusable snippets are built in, and notes are written in Markdown and stored as ordinary files. It also includes a Focus feature that hides distracting apps and blocks sites in Safari, Chrome, Brave, and Vivaldi, plus break reminders, and a workspace for finding and answering AI agent sessions.
platforms: iOS (Volant for iPhone in public beta)
notable: Free and open source, hosted on GitHub under mysticcoders/volant
Extensions are WebAssembly modules that run in a sandboxed helper and also on a browser Try it page
Clipboard history is stored encrypted on the Mac; no Volant account and no telemetry
Notes can sync via the user's own iCloud
caveats: Requires macOS 15 or later and Apple silicon
Volant for iPhone is only in public beta
Cloud AI chat uses the user's chosen provider; agent features depend on installed agents and integrations
